name: Oneirodex
description: Oneirodex is a self-hosted game library for your household. Browse a shared catalog, enrich it with metadata and artwork, organize collections, chat, and play supported systems from the browser or TV-friendly Big Picture view. One container includes the web app and PostgreSQL. Point Games at your existing game share (mounted read-only), keep Appdata on cache/SSD, and open the WebUI to start setup. Your database, settings, generated secrets, and artwork stay in Appdata. Release 1.1.8 · Multi-architecture image for amd64 and arm64. Optional metadata, workstation artwork, ClamAV, and TRAWL connections are configured by you and off until enabled. Oneirodex does not include game files, BIOS, firmware, or encryption keys. Use only software you are authorized to access. Install, backup, and update guide: https://github.com/cephyrixzyth/Oneirodex/blob/main/docs/runbooks/Unraid-community-apps.md

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Database, generated secrets, logs, themes, covers and uploads. Keep this on the cache / an SSD and include it in your appdata backup.

paths.name: Games
paths.description: Your games / ROMs share. Mounted read-only: Oneirodex only scans it.

paths.name: Extra scan location 2
paths.description: Optional second read-only scan location. Also add it to ONEIRODEX_LIBRARY_ROOTS, e.g. NAS ROMs=/storage2

variables.name: ONEIRODEX_LIBRARY_ROOTS
variables.description: Extra scan locations as the container sees them: Name=/storage2|Other=/storage3

variables.name: ONEIRODEX_LIBRARY_DIR
variables.description: Persistent location for covers, themes, generated artwork and uploads.

variables.name: Enable AI artwork
variables.description: Optional cover generation through a private Stable Diffusion API endpoint on your LAN.

variables.name: AI artwork API URL
variables.description: Optional workstation Forge / AUTOMATIC1111 API URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:7860. Keep it on a trusted LAN.

variables.name: AI artwork engine
variables.description: Compatible API mode for Forge or AUTOMATIC1111.

variables.name: Enable malware scanning
variables.description: Optional ClamAV scanning. Enable after attaching this container and a ClamAV sidecar to the same private Docker network.

variables.name: ClamAV host
variables.description: Private Docker DNS name of the optional ClamAV sidecar.

variables.name: ClamAV port
variables.description: ClamAV TCP port on the private Docker network.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the embedded database runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group the embedded database runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Leave empty: a strong key is generated on first start and kept in Appdata/secrets. Set it only if you already have one.

variables.name: Secure cookies
variables.description: Leave false for plain http on your LAN. Set true when you reach Oneirodex through an HTTPS reverse proxy.
